patterns: Do I have to pay 100% upfront?
Do I pay all at once?
responses: No, you do not have to pay 100% upfront. We believe in transparent, milestone-based payments to ensure you are completely satisfied with the progress at each stage.

Our standard payment structure is milestone-based. Typically, it involves an initial deposit to kick off the project, followed by scheduled payments tied to specific deliverable phases (e.g., design approval, beta release, final launch).

patterns: Are there any hidden costs, such as server fees or API costs?
responses: We maintain complete transparency. All development costs will be clearly outlined in your proposal. Third-party expenses like domain, hosting, or external API subscriptions are discussed upfront and are typically managed directly by the client.
